title: Ctrl-F: Force as an Interface for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid motion tracking has scaled to general policies that reproduce diverse human motion, but the resulting behavior is in free-space: the tracker knows where the body should be, not how it should interact with the environment. Other work makes the object part of the objective, yet abstracts that interaction to contact or geometry, which leaves the demanding cases under-explored. We argue that force is a natural command channel between motion imitation and object interaction, one that specifies not just where to make contact but how hard. We present Ctrl-F, a hierarchical motion-force framework that augments motion tracking with an explicit force command, a 3-D force at each designated contact body such as a hand or a foot. The hierarchical framework comprises: (1) A unified motion-force controller tracks the reference motion while applying the commanded force to the world. (2) A high-level force planner that issues a force command

translated_title: Ctrl-F：以力作为人形机器人移动操作的交互接口
translated_abstract: 人形机器人运动跟踪已经发展到能够重现多样化人类动作的通用策略，但由此产生的行为仅限于自由空间中：跟踪器知道身体应该处于什么位置，却不知道应该如何与环境进行交互。其他研究工作虽然将物体纳入了优化目标之中，但将这种交互抽象为接触或几何关系，这使得具有挑战性的场景仍未得到充分探索。我们认为，力是连接运动模仿与物体交互之间的自然指令通道，它不仅规定了在哪里进行接触，还规定了用多大的力。我们提出了Ctrl-F，这是一个分层的运动-力框架，它通过显式的力指令来增强运动跟踪，即在每个指定的接触部位（如手或脚）上施加一个三维力。该分层框架包括：(1) 一个统一的运动-力控制器，在跟踪参考运动的同时向外界施加指令力；(2) 一个负责发出力指令的高层力规划器（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出了Ctrl-F分层运动-力框架，通过在指定接触部位施加显式的三维力指令来增强人形机器人运动跟踪，使机器人不仅能模仿人类动作，还能以指定力度与环境中的物体进行交互。
en_tdlr: Ctrl-F is a hierarchical motion-force framework that augments humanoid motion tracking with explicit 3-D force commands at designated contact bodies, enabling robots to not only imitate human motion but also interact with the environment with specified force.
